chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, all from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever says, when he takes to his bed, three times:

Praise is for Allah Who is Exalted, so Subjugates; and the Praise is for Allah Who is Hidden, so is Informed; and the Praise is for Allah Who is a King, so is Powerful; and the Praise is for Allah who Revives the dead and Causes the living to die and He is Able upon everything
would come out from the sins to be as he was the day his mother gave him birth
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for sleep that erases sins according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication emphasizes Allah's absolute sovereignty and omniscience, reflecting the Shia emphasis on recognizing divine attributes before rest. The promise of sin forgiveness is interpreted by scholars as a spiritual reset, restoring the soul's innate purity (fitrah) to the state it held at birth, free from the accumulation of daily transgressions.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, altogether from Bakr Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who says when he takes to his bed,

‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who is Exalted, so Subjugates; and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who is Hidden, so is Informed; and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who is a King, so is Powerful; and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> who Revives the dead and Causes the living to die and He<sup>azwj</sup> is Able upon everything’,
would come out from the sins to be as he was the day his mother gave him birth’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad have narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq all from Bakr ibn Muhammad from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Whoever at the time of going to bed says three times,

‘All praise belongs to Allah, Who is High, thus, He is Dominant. All praise belongs to Allah, Who is hidden, thus, He knows. All praise belongs to Allah, Who owns, thus. He has measured (all things), all praise belongs to Allah, Who gives life to the dead, and causes the living to die, and He has power over all things,’
he will come out of sins just like the day he was born from his mother.’”
